theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (p : (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ)) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)), StrictMono p.1 → IsOpen N → (∀ y : Euclid (m + 1), (∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1) → (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) ∈ N) → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → ∃ γ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, tsupport (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ N ∧ (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ (y : Euclid (m + 1)) (i : Fin (m + 1)), g y i = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ) * (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun k => (p.2 k : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun l => EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 (Fin.succAbove i l)) (1 : ℝ))
